steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setUiMode('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: capture-persp-pose
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; window.__pp = { pos: [c.position.x, c.position.y, c.position.z], type: c.type }; })()

steps.name: assert-viewpoint-preserved
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; const p0 = window.__pp.pos; const d = Math.hypot(c.position.x-p0[0], c.position.y-p0[1], c.position.z-p0[2]); window.__viewpointDelta = d; if (d > 0.5) throw new Error('camera jumped on ortho toggle, delta=' + d.toFixed(3)); })()

steps.name: assert-ortho-picking
steps.eval: (() => { const t = window.__three; const rc = t.raycaster; let total = 0, furnitureHitId = null; for (const [x,y] of [[0,0],[0.15,-0.1],[-0.2,0.05],[0.1,0.2],[-0.1,-0.2]]) { rc.setFromCamera({x,y}, t.camera); const hits = rc.intersectObjects(t.scene.children, true); total += hits.length; for (const h of hits) { let o = h.object; while (o) { if (o.userData && o.userData.itemId) { furnitureHitId = o.userData.itemId; break; } o = o.parent; } if (furnitureHitId) break; } } window.__orthoPick = { total, furnitureHitId }; if (total === 0) throw new Error('ortho raycast hit nothing — picking broken'); })()

steps.name: select-picked-furniture
steps.eval: (() => { const id = window.__orthoPick.furnitureHitId; if (id) window.__store.getState().selectItem?.(id); window.__selResult = { picked: id, selected: window.__store.getState().selectedItemId }; })()

steps.name: assert-ortho-zoom-changed
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; if (c.type !== 'OrthographicCamera') throw new Error('camera left ortho on zoom'); window.__zoomIn = c.zoom; })()

steps.name: assert-not-blank
steps.eval: (() => { const c = window.__three.camera; if (!Number.isFinite(c.zoom) || c.zoom <= 0) throw new Error('ortho zoom degenerate: ' + c.zoom); })()

steps.name: walk-mode-overlay-shown
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash never appeared, so the gone-wait below would pass vacuously. If this transition genuinely raises no splash (same mode, or the room editor owns the overlay) delete BOTH guard steps rather than widening the timeout.

steps.name: walk-mode-overlay-gone
steps.failMessage: 'Entering walkthrough' splash still up; the next screenshot would capture the splash, not the scene. See docs/visual-verification-playbook.md.

steps.name: report
steps.eval: (() => { window.__report = { viewpointDelta: window.__viewpointDelta, orthoPick: window.__orthoPick, sel: window.__selResult, zoomIn: window.__zoomIn }; console.log('PARALLEL-PROJECTION REPORT', JSON.stringify(window.__report)); })()
